learning_objective: The learner can explain how supervised finetuning converts a pre-trained model's text-completion behavior into instruction-following dialogue using labeled conversational data.

common_misconceptions.description: Supervised finetuning can also be used for infilling tasks like text editing and code debugging, not just next-token prediction.
Supervised finetuning can be performed using adapter-based techniques on mid-tier GPUs, not necessarily requiring full finetuning.
Supervised finetuning is often combined with preference finetuning, and steps can be skipped depending on the desired outcome.
